_comment: PROPOSED, NOT INSTALLED. Replace <ABS_PYTHON> and <ABS_PATH_TO> with absolute paths. Codex hooks need trust review before they run. Codex keys hook trust by position (<file>:<event>:<group>:<handler>, see [hooks.state] in ~/.codex/config.toml), so APPEND these groups after every existing group in the target hooks.json (or put them in a hooks.json of their own); inserting them earlier renumbers the existing Mycelium hooks and changes which trust entry each one matches.
